description:
Generate Synapse curation-manifest CSV templates from a schema — the tabular companion to the
transform_schema synapse export. Two artifacts per type: {name}.manifest.csv (the blank entry grid,
header row only, loadable as a Curator RecordSet CSV) and {name}.dictionary.csv (the column
dictionary: Column, Type, Description, Required, Value Set — followed by a value-set section listing
taxonomy terms for dropdown columns). Source formats: jsonschema | shex | avro | jsonld | sql | osi |
osi-json | owl | linkml | odm. Stateless — the project scopes auth only; nothing is written.

sourceFormat.description: jsonschema | shex | avro | jsonld | sql | osi | osi-json | owl | linkml | odm

typeId.description: Generate manifests for this type only (matched by id or label). Omit for every type.

name: generate_synapse_manifests
title: Generate Synapse Manifests
